Several MCP tools return the same structured output. This page lists each shared shape once.

## Activity

Tool outputs use this object for each GitHub activity item. Their tables link here.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | yes | Unique id of the activity item. |
| `createdAt` | `string` | yes | When gournal stored the item, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `updatedAt` | `string` | yes | When the item last changed, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `deletedAt` | `string \| null` | yes | When the item was deleted, or null. |
| `deviceId` | `string` | yes | Id of the device that stored the item. |
| `type` | `"commit" \| "pr_opened" \| "pr_merged" \| "review"` | yes | Kind of activity: a commit, an opened PR, a merged PR, or a review. |
| `occurredAt` | `string` | yes | When the activity happened on GitHub, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `repo` | `string` | yes | Repository (owner/name). |
| `branch` | `string \| null` | yes | Git branch of the PR, or null. |
| `externalId` | `string` | yes | Id of the item on GitHub: the PR number, commit hash, or review id. |
| `title` | `string \| null` | yes | PR title or first line of the commit message, or null. |
| `url` | `string \| null` | yes | GitHub URL of the item, or null. |
| `capturedBy` | `"github"` | yes | Where the item came from. Always github. |
| `pr` | `number \| null` | yes | PR number that the item belongs to, or null. |
| `payload` | `object` | yes | Extra data from GitHub, for example the review state. |

## Entry

Tool outputs use this object for each journal entry. Their tables link here.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | yes | Unique id of the entry. The last 8 characters work as a short id. |
| `createdAt` | `string` | yes | When the entry was created, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `updatedAt` | `string` | yes | When the entry last changed, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `deletedAt` | `string \| null` | yes | When the entry was deleted, or null if it is not deleted. |
| `deviceId` | `string` | yes | Id of the device that created the entry. |
| `summary` | `string` | yes | One line that says what happened. |
| `details` | `string \| null` | yes | Longer text for the entry, or null. |
| `kind` | `"done" \| "blocker" \| "next"` | yes | done, blocker (something stops you), or next (a planned step). |
| `status` | `"open" \| "resolved" \| null` | yes | open or resolved for a blocker or next entry. Null for a done entry. |
| `resolvedAt` | `string \| null` | yes | When the entry was resolved, or null. |
| `resolvedByEntryId` | `string \| null` | yes | Id of the entry that resolved this one, or null. |
| `project` | `string` | yes | Project name. |
| `repo` | `string \| null` | yes | Repository (owner/name), or null. |
| `branch` | `string \| null` | yes | Git branch, or null. |
| `source` | `"cli" \| "mcp" \| "migration"` | yes | Where the entry came from: the CLI, the MCP server, or a migration. |
| `agent` | `string \| null` | yes | Name of the agent that logged the entry, or null. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | yes | Tags of the entry. |
| `refs` | `object[]` | yes | References such as PRs and ticket keys. |
| `refs.type` | `"pr" \| "jira" \| "commit" \| "url"` | yes | Kind of reference. |
| `refs.value` | `string` | yes | The PR number, ticket key, commit hash, or URL. |
| `refs.repo` | `string` | no | Repository (owner/name) of the reference. |

## Entry list

Tools that return this shape: [`find_entries`](/gournal/docs/reference/search/#mcp-tool-find_entries), [`list_entries`](/gournal/docs/reference/list/#mcp-tool-list_entries).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `entries` | [`Entry[]`](/gournal/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry) | yes | The matching entries. |
| `count` | `number` | yes | Number of entries returned. |

## Entry result

Tools that return this shape: [`add_entry`](/gournal/docs/reference/add/#mcp-tool-add_entry), [`delete_entry`](/gournal/docs/reference/remove-restore/#mcp-tool-delete_entry), [`resolve_entry`](/gournal/docs/reference/resolve/#mcp-tool-resolve_entry), [`update_entry`](/gournal/docs/reference/edit/#mcp-tool-update_entry).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `entry` | [`Entry`](/gournal/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry) | yes | The entry after the change. |
| `notes` | `string[]` | yes | Hints and warnings, for example a close tag name or an id that could not be resolved. |
